name: Model-TG + MACRO with Peaks drums and Sheep wavetables (47 Braids models, then PEAKS_BASS_DRUM, PEAKS_SNARE_DRUM, PEAKS_HI_HAT, PEAKS_FM_DRUM, SHEEP_A, SHEEP_B, SHEEP_C) and ACID, without the Syntakt engines
description: EXPERIMENTAL (notes/75): not tested on a Model:Cycles. Model-TG + MACRO + ACID, the five Syntakt engines are left out.
MACRO's Model knob goes to 53: 0..46 Braids (unchanged), 47..50 Peaks BASS DRUM, SNARE DRUM, HI-HAT, FM DRUM, 51..53 SHEEP A, B, C (Sheep: the wavetable oscillator of the alternative Tides firmware).

Peaks, Tides' wavetables and Braids compiled as is from pichenettes/eurorack 08460a6 (Emilie Gillet, MIT: LICENSE-Braids); our glue: tools/machines/macro/ (voices.h, peaks_glue.cc, sheep_glue.cc, sheep.h).
Models 47+ run at 48 kHz without RATE or BITS (FUNC + PITCH does nothing on them); the amp chain of the OS is kept.
ACID d'après Open303 (Robin Schmidt, licence MIT : LICENSE-Open303), lié à +0x76000, compilé avec GOV_SKIP.
